title: Jammu & Kashmir AB-PMJAY SEHAT Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health assurance programme providing cashless hospitalization to eligible J&K residents through the PM-JAY network.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on current J&K residency/beneficiary identification and SEHAT rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Jammu & Kashmir AB-PMJAY SEHAT.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
